text: Kyeryong Construction Industrial Co., Ltd. (계룡건설산업) is listed on the KOSPI market. Its large-shareholding report of 5 June 2026 (published by DigitalToday) names chairman Lee Seung-chan (이승찬) as the largest shareholder with 2,069,144 shares (23.17%), or 38.49% including related parties (relatives and the Kyeryong Scholarship Foundation).
short: KOSPI-listed; chairman Lee Seung-chan is the largest shareholder (38.49% with related parties).

source.name: 디지털투데이 (DigitalToday): 계룡건설산업 최대주주 이승찬, 계룡건설산업 주식등의 수 1만8600주 감소…총 지분율 38.49%
source.note: The article reproduces the company's large-shareholding report (주식등의대량보유상황보고서) filed to the Financial Services Commission and the Korea Exchange, including the related-party list.
source.quote: 이승찬 회장은 계룡건설산업의 최대주주로, 이번 보고서에서 주식등의 수를 1만8600주 줄였다고 보고했다. 보유 비율은 38.49%로 나타났다.
